entry.title: Designing For Distressed Users: Why Mental Health Apps Shouldn’t Follow Every UI Fashion

Kat Homan introduces an evaluation framework that helps designers assess whether trendy visual and interaction patterns support or undermine the unique goals of mental health experiences.

entry.title: Matching AI Modality To User Intent: Designing The Right Interface
